description.value: Assi Market is a Korean supermarket that has since rebranded as Market Ribbon, offering Korean grocery staples and prepared foods such as dumplings, fried chicken, and soups. It operates as a full-service supermarket in the eastern Greater Vancouver area. A touring cyclist seeking Korean specialty groceries or prepared Korean food items may find this a useful stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists this as a Korean supermarket ('Assi Market', shop=supermarket, cuisine=korean), but the website at assimarket.ca has been fully rebranded to 'Market Ribbon' with a redirect notice to www.marketribbon.ca — indicating the 'Assi Market' name is no longer in use. The website content confirms grocery/food products (Korean prepared foods, dumplings, etc.) but provides no information about bike parking, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities. No address beyond unit 330 is available in OSM, and the community field ('North Vancouver') may not match the coordinates (which appear to be in the Port Coquitlam/Coquitlam area).
concerns: Business has rebranded: OSM name 'Assi Market' is no longer in use; website assimarket.ca now displays 'Market Ribbon' branding and directs visitors to www.marketribbon.ca.
OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but coordinates (49.282N, 122.801W) appear to be in the Port Coquitlam/Coquitlam area, not North Vancouver.
No full street address available in OSM (only addr:unit=330).
